content.value_statement: Data teams need clear decisions for reliable pipelines, models, and operations. This skill provides architecture guidance, production checklists, and starter CLI scaffolds.
actual_capabilities: Guides pipeline reviews across scalability, reliability, observability, security, and cost.
Summarizes data modeling, distributed processing, real-time systems, and DataOps principles.
Provides production checklists for testing, monitoring, deployment, privacy, and incident readiness.
Supplies three Python CLI scaffolds for orchestration, quality validation, and ETL optimization workflows.
Frames architecture discussions around latency, throughput, availability, and error targets.
limitations: The Python scripts are scaffolds; their core execution methods do not process files or optimize pipelines.
Two quick-start examples use options that the corresponding scripts do not accept.
The reference guides provide high-level principles without detailed implementations or case studies.
The skill does not connect to databases, cloud services, orchestration platforms, or monitoring systems.

use_cases.title: Review a Pipeline Design
use_cases.description: Assess batch or streaming plans for reliability, quality controls, observability, scalability, security, and cost.

use_cases.title: Plan an Analytics Model
use_cases.description: Define model grain, facts, dimensions, validation rules, and operational requirements before implementation.

use_cases.title: Set Production Standards
use_cases.description: Create shared review criteria for deployment, monitoring, privacy, availability, and incident response.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Pipeline Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this batch pipeline plan: [plan]. Identify missing inputs, outputs, schedules, quality checks, and monitoring. Return a prioritized checklist.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a proposed batch workflow

prompt_templates.title: Design a Data Model
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a dimensional model for [business process] using these source tables: [sources]. Define grain, facts, dimensions, keys, and validation rules. Explain tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate an Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this pipeline architecture for [workload]: [architecture]. Compare batch and streaming options, failure recovery, observability, security, scalability, and cost. Recommend a design.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Production Readiness Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a production readiness review for [platform] with [constraints]. Cover orchestration, data contracts, lineage, privacy, deployment, incident response, and measurable service targets.

output_examples.input: Review a nightly customer pipeline that reads object storage and loads a warehouse.
output: Priority 1: define source freshness, schema expectations, and duplicate handling.
Priority 2: add retry limits, idempotent loads, and failure alerts.
Priority 3: measure completion time, record counts, and warehouse cost.

output_examples.input: Design a dimensional model for retail orders, products, stores, and customers.
output_examples.output: Use one order-line fact at transaction grain with conformed date, product, store, and customer dimensions. Validate keys, amounts, and late updates.

output_examples.input: Assess whether a ten-minute batch pipeline should become streaming.
output_examples.output: Keep batch unless the business requires lower latency. Compare operational complexity, recovery behavior, event ordering, monitoring needs, and incremental infrastructure cost.

best_practices: Provide workload volume, latency goals, failure tolerance, and cost constraints.
Validate recommendations against real source schemas, data contracts, and platform capabilities.
Test changes in a non-production environment and add measurable quality and reliability checks.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the included Python scaffolds as complete production tools.
Do not adopt generic performance targets without workload measurements and business requirements.
Do not deploy architecture recommendations without security, privacy, cost, and recovery reviews.

faq.question: Does this skill build complete data pipelines?
faq.answer: No. It guides planning and review, while the included Python files provide incomplete CLI scaffolds.

faq.question: Which data platforms does it support?
faq.answer: The guidance mentions common tools, but it does not provide platform-specific integrations or executable connectors.

faq.question: Can it review batch and streaming designs?
faq.answer: Yes. It can compare architecture choices using latency, reliability, scalability, observability, security, and cost criteria.

faq.question: Does it validate real datasets?
faq.answer: No. The data quality script does not inspect files, schemas, records, or databases.

faq.question: Can it help with data governance?
faq.answer: It can structure reviews for privacy, access control, encryption, audit logging, lineage, and operational ownership.

faq.question: Are the quick-start commands ready to run?
faq.answer: Not all commands match the current script options. Review each script interface before running an example.
